expected.meetingPurpose: Review planning status for the 10K event and assign responsibilities for safety, route, medals and promotion.
meetingObjectives: Confirm race date and entry fee.
Resolve marshal and first-aid coverage gaps.
Choose medals or shirts and confirm ordering quantity.
Agree the social media push needed to support entries.
expected.executiveSummary: The committee confirmed the 10K date and entry fee, then focused on practical event risks. Marshal recruitment and first-aid cover were identified as priorities, with Jo Marsh and Jo Bennett taking separate responsibilities. The group also discussed road-closure timing, the need for a Plan B route, medal ordering and increased social media activity to reach the break-even entry level.
discussion: Race date and GBP 15 entry fee.
Marshal shortage and requirement for 14 marshals.
Inadequate first-aid coverage and need for two crews.
Road-closure application and risk of it not being approved in time.
Need for a Plan B route if the permit is unresolved two weeks before the race.
Medals versus shirts, with medals selected.
Order quantity of 350 medals for an expected 300 runners.
Low social-media activity and its possible effect on entries.
Need for roughly 280 entries to break even.

actions.action: Get a quote from St John Ambulance for two first-aid crews, then confirm once the cost is approved.
Submit the road-closure application this week and confirm the towpath has reopened.
Run the social media push, posting every couple of days through to race day and distributing the entry link.
